name: Temporal Frequency Anomaly
description: Detects anomalous temporal frequency signatures in video — AI generation creates distinctive temporal spectral patterns.
mechanism:
This method detects temporal frequency anomalies for video deepfake detection:

1. **时间信号提取**: Per-pixel or per-region temporal signals are extracted — tracking intensity, color, and texture over time. These signals capture the temporal dynamics at each spatial location.

2. **时间频率分解**: Temporal signals are analyzed via FFT to obtain per-location temporal frequency spectra. This reveals the frequency components of temporal variation: scene motion (~0-5 Hz), lighting changes (~0-1 Hz), and potential generation artifacts.

3. **异常检测in时间Spectra**: Natural video temporal spectra are dominated by low frequencies (slow scene changes) with rapid falloff at higher frequencies. The method detects anomalous spectral components: (a) energy at incommensurate frequencies with no physical source, (b) spectral peaks at the video generator's characteristic temporal frequencies, (c) unexpected harmonics from repetitive generation patterns.

4. **空间映射of时间Anomalies**: The detected temporal frequency anomalies are mapped spatially. Anomalies concentrated in face regions (but absent in background) strongly indicate face-specific generation artifacts. The spatial distribution of temporal anomalies reveals the extent and boundaries of generated content.

5. **Cross-频率相干性**: In natural video, temporal frequency components at different spatial frequencies are coherently related (same physical motion produces correlated temporal variations at all spatial frequencies). The method checks cross-frequency coherence — AI generation may produce temporally incoherent variations at different spatial scales.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
